name: Chawp
look: a little scrapper with a huge round head, big determined eyes, a white plate on its brow, a cheek bandage, grey barrel shorts with black cuffs and raised mitten fists
entry: It picks fights with anything bigger than itself just to prove how tough it is, and it never stays down. Whether it trains its strikes, its throws or its kicks decides what it becomes.
how: Wild: uncommon in hills, mountains and plains; common around dojos.
Evolves at level 20: into Sawk if its Attack is higher than its Defence, into Throh if its Defence is higher, and into Kiq if they're equal (like Tyrogue).
